system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Perform action: Sends OTP for Kisan Call Centre authentication. For your information, my mobile_number is 9876563377, my aadhaar_number is 100020004832.

function.name: kcc_generate_otp
function.description: Sends OTP for Kisan Call Centre authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid.

function.name: kcc_assign_grievance
function.description: Assigns a grievance to an appropriate expert/department based on category. Transitions grievance_status to 'assigned'. Requires session_token. Grievance must be in 'raised' status. Does NOT resolve grievances. Fails if already assigned or category routing is ambiguous.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
